verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of runtime versioning, model-file format compatibility, or what happens to previously downloaded quantized checkpoints when the Edge0 runtime is upgraded. The closest item says adapter upgrades swap only adapter files and leave the base read-only, but that describes adapter updates, not runtime-upgrade compatibility. Tier auto-detection from config.json is likewise unrelated to compatibility guarantees.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
